title: The Decomposition Tax: LLM Pipelines Lose Up to 40 Accuracy Points at Their Own Interfaces

paragraphs.en: A four-stage LLM pipeline gives up as much as 40.5 accuracy points at its own interfaces (gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19; the largest tax in the primary family). We hold model, problem, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, vary only whether each stage can still see the original problem, and call the accuracy difference the decomposition tax. Across 21 open-weight models from nine organisations, on GSM-Hard and MATH-500 at n = 200 paired items per cell, 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction and 54 survive Holm. On GSM-Hard, a placebo recovers nothing: it carries at least 60% of the extra tokens and at most one word of the problem. Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. Rewriting one stage’s instruction moves gemma-3-12B’s tax from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and adding “every relationship stated between them” to a stage that lists the numerical quantities lowers the tax on 9 of 9 models on MATH-500. Re-grounding, which shows a stage the original problem again, belongs after the loss. With one lossy interface, re-grounding the stage after it beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks; on MATH-500 the earlier repair is worse than none on 7 of 7. Newer models still pay: gemma-4-12B gives up 37.0 points, and the repair holds on all three of the newest models we test. A sealed held-out test refuted a stronger rule we registered, which predicted the paying stage from the interface and receiver types, so we locate the tax by measuring one stage at a time. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships.

paragraphs.en: Multi-stage LLM pipelines build one answer from several calls, and they differ in how much each call still sees. Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) carries every earlier answer forward, while Decomposed Prompting ( Khot et al., 2023 ) hands each sub-task handler only its sub-query. A pipeline enters the one-message regime whenever a context budget or a role boundary lets only a single message cross an interface: each later stage then reasons only from what an earlier stage chose to write down. This paper prices that regime.
paragraphs.zh: 多阶段 LLM 流程通过多次调用构建一个答案，而各次调用所能看到的信息量则有所不同。 “从少到多”提示方法（Zhou 等，2023）会将所有前序答案传递下去，而“分解提示”方法（Khot 等，2023）则仅将子查询交给每个子任务处理者。 当上下文预算或角色边界导致仅有一条消息能通过接口时，该流程便会进入单消息模式：此时后续各阶段只能基于前一阶段所选择写入的内容进行推理。 本文对这一模式进行了量化评估。

paragraphs.en: Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. The frameworks we know of let a builder rewrite a stage’s prompt, and none puts a price on the interface between two stages. Failure studies catalogue and repair what goes wrong at that interface ( Cemri et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . The closest measurement of its cost ( Radhakrishnan et al., 2023 ) changes both the call structure and what each stage can see. We price the interface alone.
paragraphs.zh: 构建者一次设计一个阶段，其账单则出现在各阶段之间的接口处。 我们所知的框架允许构建者重写某个阶段的提示，但没有框架会为两个阶段之间的接口定价。 故障研究会记录并修复该接口处出现的问题（Cemri 等人，2025；Lin 等人，2026）。 对其成本最接近的测量方法（Radhakrishnan 等人，2023）同时改变了调用结构以及每个阶段所能看到的内容。 我们仅对接口本身进行定价。

paragraphs.en: We call that price the decomposition tax . In the strict arm each stage sees only the previous stage’s output. In the full arm we re-ground each stage: it also sees the original problem. TAX = acc(full) − - acc(strict) , paired per item, is what re-grounding buys back, and so what the interfaces were costing. Both arms share model, stages, stage prompts and completion cap. A single chain-of-thought call on the same model, the monolith, is the reference. On MATH-500, gemma-3-12B solves 15.0% of problems in the strict arm and 55.5% in the full arm. Strong models pay too: gemma-4-12B, which solves 86.5% of MATH-500 in one call, gives up 37.0 points. Re-grounding one stage alone, arm g_i , measures how much of the tax falls on stage i , its incidence : STAGE_TAX(i) = acc(g_i) − - acc(strict) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这个价格称为分解税。 在严格模式中，每个阶段只能看到前一阶段的输出。 在完整模式中，我们对每个阶段进行重新定位：它还能看到原始问题。 税收 = acc(完整) − acc(严格)，按项目配对计算，这反映了重新定位所挽回的价值，也即接口所造成的成本。 两种模式共享相同的模型、阶段、阶段提示和完成上限。 对同一模型（单体模型）进行一次思维链调用是基准参考。 在 MATH-500 数据集上，gemma-3-12B 在严格模式下能解决 15.0% 的问题，而在完整模式下能解决 55.5%。 强大模型也会受到影响：gemma-4-12B 单次调用即可解决 MATH-500 的 86.5%，但会损失 37.0 分。 单独对某个阶段进行重新定位（模式 g_i），可以衡量该阶段需要承担多少税收，即其税负：STAGE_TAX(i) = acc(g_i) − acc(严格)。

paragraphs.en: Two 2 × \times 2 squares take one interface apart. A three-stage square crosses what the sender keeps (CONTENT) with how it writes (FORM); a four-stage square crosses the sender’s whole instruction (EDGE) with what the receiver may do (RECEIVER). Two mixed-order pipelines place one lossy, condensing interface early or late, which separates the interface from stage position. Figure 1 summarises the instrument and the findings.

paragraphs.en: The largest tax in the primary family is gemma-3-12B on MATH-500, A_asset : +0.4050, Holm-corrected p = 1.66e-19 across all 118 primary tests. The tax is common: on A_asset its bootstrap interval excludes zero for 17 of 20 models on MATH-500 and 16 of 20 on GSM-Hard, and 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg ( 54 survive Holm). Keeping one test per cell (this drops eight greedy re-runs) and applying the registered parse gate on the strict arm leaves 52 of 94 tests surviving Benjamini-Hochberg and 43 Holm, with this cell at p = 1.32e-19 ( out/headline_family.txt ). Appendix D applies the registered parse and empty-output gates in turn. The second, no empty stage output, would exclude this cell: two of its 200 full-arm items carry an empty intermediate message from the second stage. We keep it, because every final answer in that arm parses and two items in 200 can move the tax by at most one point.

paragraphs.en: The tax is the missing problem. Registered controls address the obvious alternatives (Appendix D). A placebo on A_asset , run on GSM-Hard, replaces all but at most one of the problem’s words with ___ while keeping its layout and word count. It carries at least 60% of full re-grounding’s extra tokens and recovers -0.0100 / -0.0050 / -0.0100 on its three models. Twenty sampled seeds on Qwen2.5-7B average +0.3922 against a greedy +0.3800 on MATH-500, and no MATH-500 strict or full arm at the 4096-token corpus budget parses below 0.955 . The same cell on a second GPU architecture gives +0.3850 against +0.3800 , and rewording the depth-4 square without mathematical vocabulary leaves its condensing tax in place on 4 of 5 models (Section 3.2). A budget sweep over other models, run in place of the registered headline-cell control, moves the tax by at most 0.055 on MATH-500. Re-grounding half of the problem recovers almost nothing, so recovery does not grow in step with how much of the problem a stage sees. The registered proportional prediction held on 0 of 3 models. Across cells the full arm reads a median 1.17 × \times the strict arm’s tokens (Appendix E).
paragraphs.zh: 税收是缺失的问题。 已注册的控制措施处理了明显的替代方案（附录 D）。 在 GSM-Hard 上运行的针对 A_asset 的安慰剂，会将问题中除最多一个词外的所有词语替换为 ___，同时保持其布局和词数。 它至少携带了完全重新奠基所增加标记的 60%，并在其三种模型上分别恢复了 -0.0100 / -0.0050 / -0.0100。 在 Qwen2.5-7B 上对二十个采样种子进行测试，其与 MATH-500 上的贪心方法相比平均提升 +0.3922，并且在 4096 标记语料预算下，没有任何 MATH-500 严格或完全分支的解析分数低于 0.955。 在第二种 GPU 架构上运行相同的单元格，与 +0.3800 相比提升了 +0.3850；而无需数学词汇地重述深度为 4 的正方形，则使其中四个模型保留了其压缩税收（第 3.2 节）。 在其他模型上进行预算扫描，并替代已注册的标题单元格控制运行，在 MATH-500 上最多使税收变动 0.055。 重新奠基问题的一半几乎没有任何恢复效果，因此恢复程度并未随着某个阶段所看到的问题部分而线性增长。 已注册的比例预测在三个模型中无一奏效。 在所有单元格中，完全分支读取的标记数量是中位数上严格分支的 1.17 × \times（附录 E）。

On GSM-Hard, where we registered it, our prediction that content would reach 0.08 and lead form by 2x held on at most 1 of 4 models, and form stayed within 0.05 of zero on 3 of 4, as registered ( out/amend10_score.txt ). In the 2024 cohort the two compound, so a condensing list costs more than condensing alone and a list alone add up to. The depth-4 square crosses the edge, here a condensing list against a preserving prose restatement, with the receiver. paragraphs.en: The depth-4 tax survives rewording. Every corner above asks for “the numerical quantities given”. On the depth-4 square’s condensing, committed corner, rewording every stage without mathematical vocabulary leaves gemma-3-12B paying +0.4500 against +0.3550 with the vocabulary ( out/amend9_score.txt ). At depth 3 the same rewording removes between 0.1150 and 0.3500 of the condensing list’s MATH-500 tax on each of the seven models with a tax ( out/oneword_effect.txt ), so the depth-3 square measures content and form inside a mathematical wording.

paragraphs.en: Re-grounding the stage after the loss beats re-grounding the stage before it on 7 of 7 models on both benchmarks. That is 4 of 4 in the 2024 cohort, and 3 of 3 in the 2026 cohort, for which we registered the MATH-500 test before its cells ran. On MATH-500 re-grounding the stage before the loss does worse than no repair on 7 of 7 (by 0.005 to 0.070; p = 0.016, two-sided sign test), against 3 of 7 on GSM-Hard. On gemma-3-12B, stage 1 alone recovers -0.0250; stage 2 alone recovers +0.2350 of the +0.2500 that re-grounding every stage recovers. By its registered reading, which of two stages after the loss helps more is then set by the stage’s own prompt or its position, not by which interface precedes it. Stage 2 runs the same solve prompt in both pipelines (Appendix F). paragraphs.en: Decomposition and its cost. Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) and Decomposed Prompting ( Khot et al., 2023 ) split a problem across calls, and PAL ( Gao et al., 2022 ) hands the solving step to an interpreter. Each measures what its design buys, and recent work adds error recovery to it ( Hernández-Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) . Radhakrishnan et al. (2023) measure what an isolated context costs, but their arms change the call structure and what each call sees together, and none is both decomposed and re-grounded. Our arms differ in what each stage sees alone. DnDScore ( Wanner et al., 2025 ) checks decomposed subclaims against their source context. This is our full arm used as a method; we use it as an instrument.

paragraphs.en: Format, context and compute. Sclar et al. (2024) vary a whole prompt’s format, and Lost in the Middle ( Liu et al., 2024 ) varies where information sits. We vary what one interface carries with every other byte fixed, and a placebo separates missing content from missing length. Test-time compute work varies the budget ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) ; we fix the completion cap and vary only what each stage can see. The decomposition tax is what these lines leave unmeasured: one interface, with the rest of the pipeline fixed. Appendix I gives the full account.
paragraphs.zh: 格式、上下文与计算资源。Sclar 等人（2024）改变了整个提示的格式，而《迷失于中间》（Liu 等人，2024）则改变了信息所处的位置。我们改变单一接口所承载的内容，同时保持其余所有字节不变，并通过一个安慰剂将缺失内容与缺失长度区分开来。测试时的计算资源工作会改变预算（Snell 等人，2024；Wu 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025a）；我们固定了生成结果的长度上限，仅改变每个阶段所能看到的内容。分解成本正是这些方法未能衡量的部分：即一个接口，而其余流程保持不变。附录 I 提供了完整说明。

paragraphs.en: Builders design a pipeline one stage at a time, and its bill arrives at the interfaces between stages. With model, stages, stage prompts and completion budget fixed, the tax reaches 40.5 accuracy points , and 70 of 118 primary-family tests survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction. The tax is the missing problem: on GSM-Hard, a placebo carrying at least 60% of the extra tokens recovers nothing. One stage’s instruction moves it from 4.5 to 36.5 points, and with one lossy interface the repair belongs after it in both cohorts. The prescription has two parts: re-ground the stage after the lossy interface, and if a stage must list the quantities, tell it to keep the relationships. A sealed test refuted a stronger registered rule that predicted which stage pays from the interface and receiver types; the tax and the repair rest on other pipelines and stand.
paragraphs.zh: 构建者一次设计一个阶段，其账单则出现在各阶段之间的接口处。 在模型、阶段、阶段提示和完成预算固定的情况下，该“税”达到 40.5 个准确率点，且 118 项核心家庭测试中有 70 项通过了 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正。 这种“税”正是缺失的关键问题：在 GSM-Hard 上，一个至少携带了额外标记 60% 的安慰剂却未能恢复任何效果。 单个阶段的指令可使其得分从 4.5 提升至 36.5 点；若存在一个有损耗的接口，则修复步骤应在此之后进行，且适用于两个队列。 该方案包含两部分：在有损耗接口之后重新确立阶段的基础，并且如果某个阶段必须列出数量，则需指示其保留各要素之间的关系。 一项封闭测试推翻了此前更强有力的注册规则——该规则曾根据接口和接收器类型预测由哪个阶段支付费用；而“税”与“修复”则基于其他流程并独立存在。

paragraphs.en: The practical risk in a result like this is over-application. The prescriptions in this paper are measured on two mathematical-reasoning benchmarks with a fixed pipeline family. We do not know that they transfer to retrieval, planning, code, or tool-use pipelines, and what evidence we have points the other way on magnitude: on the one non-mathematical task we could measure cleanly the tax is smaller on 4 of 4 paired comparisons over 2 models , which is a direction and not a result (Appendix H, limitation 8). A reader who prefers prose to a list at a lossy edge in a setting where the list is machine-parsed downstream would be extrapolating past our evidence, and one who assumes the 40.5-point figure travels to a non-mathematical pipeline would be extrapolating past it in the other direction.
paragraphs.zh: 此类结果的实际风险在于过度应用。 本文提出的方案在两个数学推理基准上进行了评估，并采用了一个固定的流程族。 我们尚不清楚这些方案能否迁移到检索、规划、代码或工具使用流程中；而现有证据在规模方面则指向相反方向：在唯一一项非数学任务中，我们能够清晰地测量到，在 2 个模型共 4 组配对比较中，该“税负”有 4 组结果更小——这仅表明了一种趋势，而非最终结论（附录 H，局限性 8）。 在一个列表会在下游被机器解析的场景中，若某位读者更倾向于散文而非列表，且处于信息丢失的边缘情况，那么他就是在超出我们现有证据的范围进行外推；而若有人假设那 40.5 分的数值能迁移到非数学流程中，则他是在另一个方向上超出了该证据的范围。

paragraphs.en: The corpus holds 21 open-weight models , but no single cell shape covers all of them, and a claim is only as wide as the cells that carry it. The headline A_asset design covers 20 models on MATH-500 and 20 on GSM-Hard , of which 17 and 16 carry the claim; the rest have bootstrap intervals spanning zero and are drawn grey in Figure 2. The 2x2 designs are narrower, because a square needs all four corners and a model with three of them contributes to no main effect and no interaction: the depth-4 square covers 11 models on each benchmark, and the depth-3 square 9 on MATH-500 and 4 on GSM-Hard. paragraphs.en: The gaps are not a sample. At the corpus budget exactly one model is absent, on both benchmarks: OLMo-2-13B , whose 4096-token context window means it runs only at max_tokens 1024 and is therefore not budget-matched to the rest, an exclusion by design rather than a cell that has not run. paragraphs.en: What one cell resolves. At n = 200 the median bootstrap 95% interval on a per-cell tax is 0.1100 wide, so a single cell resolves about +-0.0550 ( out/power_audit.txt , over 444 cells; 265 of them, 60%, have intervals excluding zero). paragraphs.en: What the registration was written for, and where the family partition came from. The registration was written before any local-model call for a different primary claim: a classifier, Edge-Typed Grounding, that reads a pipeline’s prompts and re-grounds only the stages it selects, with the tax contrast as its negative control (registration §1). Its confirmatory family of seven predictions, P1 to P5b (registration 5.4), was never scored and was withdrawn by Amendment 24 on 2026-09-22, a month after the campaign ended. Of those predictions, P1, P2a, P2b, P5a and P5b are contradicted by data reported here, and P4a is disfavoured. P1 predicted that the preserving shapes carry no tax, with an interval inside +-0.02; they carry up to +0.3400 ( B_asset , Qwen3-4B, MATH-500), and at n = 200, where the median interval is 0.1100 wide (Appendix C), an interval that narrow is rare. P2a and P2b predicted that a stage pays only where a condensing interface feeds a committed receiver, and pays more there than where it feeds a re-deriving one; in HO1_cross the re-deriving stage pays more on all four models (Appendix F). P5a and P5b predicted a tax inside +-0.02 at HO1_cross ’s stage 3 and across HO2_formal ; Appendix F reports 0 of 4 models inside that band for each. P4a predicted that the classifier-guided pipeline beats a single call; that arm is not in this paper, and the fully re-grounded pipeline, which re-grounds every stage the classifier could select, wins 17 of 104 A_asset cells (Limitation 1). The sealed held-out predictions S1 to S7 (§6) overlap them: S1 to S4 restate P5a and P5b. Appendix F scores all seven. Section 10 of the registration lists framings it does not license, “the decomposition tax, measured” among them; that entry recorded a positioning choice made before the campaign, and this paper’s framing departs from it. The per-cell partition used here was never registered during the campaign: only PRIMARY and SEEDREP are named in amendments, on 2026-08-20 and 2026-08-21, after 339 and 902 of the 1,025 result files had been written, and the partition itself is first written down in Amendment 24, after the campaign. What is assigned from the registration is membership, since a cell’s family follows from its manifest fields, model, shape, task, temperature, re-grounding fraction and control flag, and never from how it came out. What was arrived at during the campaign is the partition those fields map onto.
paragraphs.zh: 注册文件所针对的内容，以及家庭划分源自何处。 该注册文件是在任何本地模型调用之前为另一个主要主张编写的：一个名为“边缘类型接地”的分类器，它会读取流程的提示，仅对其选择的阶段进行重新接地，并以税收对比作为其阴性对照（注册 §1）。 其包含七个预测的确认性家族（P1 至 P5b，注册 5.4）从未被评分，并于 2026-09-22 通过第 24 号修正案撤回，此时距离活动结束仅一个月。 在这些预测中，P1、P2a、P2b、P5a 和 P5b 与本文报告的数据相矛盾，而 P4a 则不被支持。 P1 预测保留形状不产生任何税收，置信区间在 +-0.02 以内；但实际最高可达 +0.3400（B_asset、Qwen3-4B、MATH-500），且在 n = 200 时，中位数区间宽度为 0.1100（附录 C），如此窄的区间极为罕见。 P2a 和 P2b 预测：仅当凝聚界面为已承诺接收器提供输入时，该阶段才会产生费用，且此时产生的费用高于其为重新推导器提供输入时的费用；但在 HO1_cross 中，所有四种模型均显示重新推导阶段产生的费用更高（附录 F）。 P5a 和 P5b 预测 HO1_cross 的第 3 阶段以及整个 HO2_formal 的税收应在 +-0.02 范围内；但附录 F 报告称，在每种情况下，四种模型中均无一个落入该区间。 P4a 预测由分类器引导的流程优于单次调用；但该分支未包含在本文中，而完全重新接地的流程（对分类器可能选择的每个阶段都进行重新接地）在 104 个 A_asset 单元格中赢了 17 个（局限性 1）。 密封保留的预测 S1 至 S7（§6）与这些预测重叠：S1 至 S4 重复表达了 P5a 和 P5b。 附录 F 对全部七个预测进行了评分。 注册文件的第 10 节列出了其未授权的框架，其中包括“已测量的分解税”；该条目记录了在活动开始前做出的定位选择，而本文的框架与此不同。 本文使用的每单元格划分从未在活动中注册过：修正案中仅提到了 PRIMARY 和 SEEDREP，时间分别为 2026-08-20 和 2026-08-21，此时 1,025 个结果文件中已有 339 个和 902 个被编写完成，而划分本身直到活动结束后的第 24 号修正案中才被首次记录。 从注册文件中分配的内容是成员资格，因为一个单元格的家族由其显式字段、模型、形状、任务、温度、重新接地比例和控制标志决定，而非其最终结果。 在活动中得出的结果是这些字段所映射到的划分。

paragraphs.en: S1 (stage 1 taxed on at least three of four) holds on 2 of 4 and fails. S2 (stage 3 null) holds on 0 of 4 and fails, while the rival’s prediction that stage 3 is taxed holds on 4 of 4 . S3, the ordering the rule exists to produce, is reversed on every model , with stage 3 taxed at least three times as much as stage 1 on three of them. HO2_formal makes every edge sufficient, so the rule predicts no tax anywhere; the measured full - strict is -0.0850, +0.0600, +0.0950, +0.1050 , and S4 holds on 0 of 4. S5 predicted no tax on bool_eval , one of the synthetic CASCADE tasks of Appendix H, where the rival predicts one, and lost as scored, on three cells of which one parses below the 0.50 floor of Appendix D; S6, that logic_deduction would carry the largest tax, was not scored; S7, that the R1-distilled receiver pays nothing at stage 1, was void. The four decisive predictions are S2, S4, S5 and S7, and losing two refutes the rule: S2, S4 and S5 lost, and S7 was void. S2 and S4, both on GSM-Hard, meet the two-loss rule on their own.

paragraphs.en: What the data supports instead, with its confound named. In HO1_cross the peak stage tax sits at stage 3, solve , on all four models, and it is not simply that later is better: stage 4, format , sits after stage 3 and is taxed less on every model (+0.115 against +0.270, +0.180 against +0.460, +0.135 against +0.245, +0.030 against +0.035). The reading the data supports is that the tax lives at the stage doing the substantive reasoning rather than at the stage whose receiver is forbidden to reason. HO1_cross cannot separate that reading from a second one, that a re-deriving receiver pays, because solve is both the reasoning stage and a re-deriving receiver. The committed setup stage, which also does substantive work, is taxed +0.0800 on Qwen2.5-7B and +0.0900 on gemma-3-12B, three to five times less than solve . paragraphs.en: The registration fixed two readings in advance. If all three tests passed, the drop would be written as one mechanism: newer models comply better under decomposition and so lose less. Strict-arm accuracy is that reading’s only measure; we did not measure compliance on the newer models. If the depth-4 edge test failed, what shrank between cohorts would not be the same phenomenon, and the drop would compare two different things. paragraphs.en: We registered the invariance of the tax’s make-up as a prediction, and it failed from two directions. On MATH-500, the 2026 cohort’s edge effect is positive on only 2 of 3 models, and on gemma-4-12B it is +0.0125 while the receiver effect is +0.1425 , the reverse of its own direct predecessor. Separately, a registered prediction required the depth-3 square’s content-and-form interaction to reach +0.05 on two of the three 2026-cohort models; per model it is +0.0275 , +0.0300 and -0.0050 , so that prediction fails too ( out/amend1516_score.txt ). paragraphs.en: Read from the other end, the same data says how much of that loss sits at the interfaces. paragraphs.en: The budget caveat stands and bounds how far the mono column can be pushed. Of the fourteen (model, task) pairs run at more than one completion budget, only three reach a budget where the monolith truncates at most 10 of 200 items and the strict arm parses at least 0.98; raising the cap trades one failure for the other, and Qwen3-4B on MATH-500 goes from 59 truncations at 4096 tokens to 15 at 16384 while parse_rate falls from 1.000 to 0.875 ( out/budget_sweep.txt ). So the monolith numbers are a bound rather than a clean baseline – which is a reason to read them carefully, not a reason to withhold them. None of it touches the tax , which is acc(full) - acc(strict) between two pipelines of identical depth, with the monolith in neither arm.

paragraphs.en: 6. There is no compute-matched control. In Appendix E the token ratio across 444 cells accounts for 29% of the tax’s variance, a correlation that cannot separate tokens from content, and the GSM-Hard placebo shows that at least 60% of the added tokens, with at most one word of the problem, buys nothing. What neither shows is what happens if the strict arm is handed the full arm’s token budget to spend on something else: more reasoning, a second attempt, a longer answer. That is the cleanest form of the objection and it is not answered here.
paragraphs.zh: 6. 不存在计算能力匹配的控制机制。 在附录 E 中，444 个单元格中的标记比率占税收方差的 29%，这种相关性无法将标记与内容区分开来，而 GSM-Hard 安慰剂实验表明，至少 60% 的额外标记（最多仅包含问题中的一个词）并未带来任何效果。 但这两项研究都没有说明：如果将严格组的完整标记预算交给另一组用于其他用途——例如增加推理、进行第二次尝试或提供更长的答案——会发生什么。 这是该反对意见最直接的表述，但本文并未对此作出回应。

paragraphs.en: Why only two models, and what the exclusions are. Six models ran on LastLetter; the rest of the roster did not. Qwen3-8B can do the task and has a clean preserving cell (parse 0.965 , tax +0.1150 , monolith 0.910 ), but its MATH-500 partner never ran, so it has no pair, and its condensing cell parses 0.735 . The other three failed the instrument rather than the hypothesis, and the monolith arm, which every cell already runs, decides which. Ministral-8B parses 0.000 of its pipeline output on LastLetter, and its monolith scores 0.085 : it cannot do the task in a single call either, so it cannot inform a decomposition cost on it. R1-Distill-Llama-8B is the same case at a monolith of 0.055 . gpt-oss-20B is the opposite and the more interesting one: its monolith scores 0.925 , so the model can do the task, but its pipeline arm parses 0.650 – here the pipeline really does destroy the answer format, which is a cost, but a different cost from the accuracy tax and not one this paper measures. MMLU is excluded outright: the condensing interface discards the answer options along with everything else, so the final stage cannot name a letter it never saw, and the strict arm parses 0.295 . The criterion we apply throughout is the one those cases share – a model whose monolith cannot do a task cannot inform the decomposition cost on that task – and it is checkable from data every cell already produces.

paragraphs.en: Decomposition as a method, and where each system sits. Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) and Decomposed Prompting ( Khot et al., 2023 ) established the regime this paper measures: split a hard problem into stages, prompt each one separately, pass the result along.
paragraphs.zh: 分解作为一种方法，以及每个系统所处的位置。 “从少到多”提示法（Zhou 等，2023）和“分解提示法”（Khot 等，2023）确立了本文所测量的研究范式：将一个难题拆分为多个阶段，分别对每个阶段进行提示，然后将结果传递下去。

sents.en: Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) and Decomposed Prompting ( Khot et al., 2023 ) established the regime this paper measures: split a hard problem into stages, prompt each one separately, pass the result along.
sents.zh: “从少到多”提示法（Zhou 等，2023）和“分解提示法”（Khot 等，2023）确立了本文所测量的研究范式：将一个难题拆分为多个阶段，分别对每个阶段进行提示，然后将结果传递下去。

paragraphs.en: They do not all pass the same amount along, and our strict arm is the lossy end rather than the common case. Decomposed Prompting is the closest: its sub-task handlers receive their sub-query and not the original question, though a decomposer retains the question throughout. Least-to-most is further away. It solves subproblems in sequence and, in its own words, “solving each subproblem is facilitated by the answers to previously solved subproblems”, so every prior answer travels forward. PAL is further still: it is a single LLM call that emits a program, with the solving step offloaded to a Python interpreter, so no second LLM stage reads a first stage’s output at all. For AutoGen we could not establish the visibility model from the paper and make no claim about it.
paragraphs.zh: 它们并非都将相同数量的信息传递下去，而我们严格的执行机制更像是存在损耗的终端，而非普遍情况。 分解提示法最为接近：其子任务处理器接收的是子查询而非原始问题，尽管分解器在整个过程中都会保留原始问题。 从易到难法则则更远一些。 它按顺序解决子问题，用其自身的说法就是，“解决每个子问题都得益于先前已解决的子问题的答案”，因此每个先前的答案都会被传递下去。 PAL 则更为不同：它仅通过一次 LLM 调用生成程序，而实际求解步骤则由 Python 解释器完成，因此第二个 LLM 阶段完全不会读取第一阶段的结果。 对于 AutoGen，我们无法根据论文确定其可见性模型，因此对此不作任何断言。

paragraphs.en: Two things follow. Our strict arm removes both the original problem and the earlier stages’ outputs, keeping only the immediately previous one; least-to-most removes neither. So TAX as we measure it contains the loss from dropping history as well as the loss from dropping the problem, and this paper does not separate them. What strict models is the regime a pipeline falls into when a context budget forces it to carry one message between stages, which we take to be common in deployed systems and do not demonstrate here. PAL ( Gao et al., 2022 ) states the premise we test almost exactly, that models decompose reliably and fail in the solving step, and it is the paper that contributed GSM-Hard, one of our two benchmarks. Recent work adds error-recovery machinery to the decomposition itself ( Hernández-Gutiérrez et al., 2025 ) , which presumes a cost worth recovering from. Our contribution is not a better decomposition method: it is the finding that the loss is not where the method papers assume, and an address for it.
paragraphs.zh: 由此得出两点。 我们的严格机制会移除原始问题以及前几个阶段的输出，仅保留紧邻的前一个阶段的结果；而“从最少到最多”的方法则不会移除任何内容。 因此，我们所测量的 TAX 既包含因丢弃历史信息而产生的损失，也包含因丢弃问题本身而产生的损失，而本文并未对二者进行区分。 当上下文预算迫使系统在每个阶段之间仅传递一条消息时，该机制会使模型陷入何种严格模式？我们认为这种情况在部署系统中很常见，但本文不作演示。 PAL（Gao 等人，2022）几乎完全陈述了我们所检验的前提：模型能够可靠地分解任务，但在求解步骤中会失败；而本文也贡献了 GSM-Hard——我们两个基准测试之一。 近期的研究在分解过程本身中加入了错误恢复机制（Hernández-Gutiérrez 等人，2025），但这需要存在值得恢复的成本作为前提。 我们的贡献并非提出一种更优的分解方法，而是发现损失并不如方法类论文所假设的那样产生，并为此提供了相应的解释。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior measurement, and what it confounds. Radhakrishnan et al. (2023) compare chain-of-thought prompting, CoT decomposition (subquestions and their answers generated in one context) and factored decomposition (each subquestion answered in a new context), and report 86.0 , 85.6 and 81.8 accuracy averaged over four QA tasks on one Claude-family model (their Table 4). The 3.8 -point drop between their last two arms is the closest published quantity to our tax, and it is prior: that answering in an isolated context costs accuracy was measured, and named, in 2023. Two things separate it from what we report. Their two decomposition arms differ in two ways at once, because moving from CoT decomposition to factored decomposition changes both the number of sampling calls and what each call may see, where ours differ in one with the call structure frozen. And their design contains no arm that is decomposed into separate calls and re-grounded, which is the arm that wins here. What this paper adds to their 3.8 points is a measurement on open-weight models with one factor changed, an address for it, and a repair with a direction. Their strongest arm is the monolith at 86.0 , and so is ours: across our corpus the re-grounded pipeline still loses to a single call. We agree with them about the ranking and differ about which quantity is interesting: of the gap a strict pipeline opens against a single call, re-grounding every stage recovers a median 63% , and the third that remains is what a fully re-grounded pipeline still loses to a single call (Limitation 1).
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的先前测量结果及其混淆因素。Radhakrishnan等人（2023）比较了思维链提示（CoT）、CoT分解（子问题及其答案在单一上下文中生成）和因子分解（每个子问题在新上下文中回答），并报告了在一款Claude系列模型上四个问答任务中平均准确率为86.0、85.6和81.8（见其表4）。他们最后两种方法之间3.8个百分点的下降，是我们所讨论的“税收”效应最接近的已发表数值，而且这一结果已有先例：2023年就已测量并指出，在孤立上下文中回答会降低准确性。但这一结果与我们报告的内容存在两点不同。他们的两种分解方法同时存在两个差异：从CoT分解转向因子分解时，既改变了采样调用的次数，也改变了每次调用可能接触的信息；而我们的方法仅在一个方面存在差异，且调用结构保持不变。此外，他们的设计中没有任何一种方法是将任务分解为独立调用并重新建立语境的，而这正是我们方法中表现最佳的部分。本文在他们提出的3.8个百分点之外，补充了一项针对开放权重模型、在单一因素变化下的测量结果，指出了该效应的影响范围，并提供了一个有明确方向的改进方案。他们最强的方法是整体式方法，准确率为86.0；我们的最强方法也是如此：在整个语料库中，重新建立语境的流程仍然不如单次调用。我们在排名顺序上与他们一致，但在哪种数值更具意义这一点上存在分歧：严格流程与单次调用之间的差距中，通过每一阶段都重新建立语境，可以恢复其中位数的63%；而剩余的第三部分，则是完全重新建立语境的流程仍输给单次调用的幅度（局限性1）。

paragraphs.en: Who has already priced a decomposition, and in which currency. Three peer-reviewed results bear on the quantity rather than on the method. AgentAsk ( Lin et al., 2026 ) localises multi-agent failure at the inter-agent message handoff and supplies an edge-level taxonomy of it — data gap, signal corruption, referential drift, capability gap — repaired by a learned module that asks a clarifying question at the edge, for up to 4.69% accuracy at under 10% added latency. Every category there is an error on the edge; our tax is what the same edge costs when nothing on it is wrong, since no fault is injected in any arm, and our repair adds no agent, no call and no question — only the problem back into an existing stage’s prompt. Decomposition Dilemmas ( Hu et al., 2025 ) measures the same trade-off we do, in fact-checking: accuracy gained by decomposing against noise introduced by it. DnDScore ( Wanner et al., 2025 ) then verifies each decomposed subclaim back in the context it was decomposed out of, which is our full arm published as a method — the difference being that they propose it as a fix and we use it as an instrument, to price what its absence costs.
paragraphs.zh: 谁已经对分解进行了定价，以及是以哪种货币定价的。 三项经过同行评审的结果关注的是数量而非方法本身。 AgentAsk（Lin 等人，2026）将多智能体故障定位在智能体间的消息传递交接环节，并提供了边缘层面的故障分类——数据缺失、信号失真、参照漂移和能力差距——这些故障可通过一个学习模块进行修复，该模块会在边缘层面提出澄清性问题，在增加延迟低于 10% 的情况下，可将准确率提升最多 4.69%。 这里的每一类错误都发生在边缘层面；我们的“税收”指的是当边缘层面没有任何问题时其本身所消耗的成本，因为任何分支都没有被注入故障，而我们的修复方案并未增加智能体、调用或问题——只是将问题重新引入现有阶段的提示中。 分解困境（Hu 等人，2025）衡量了我们同样关注的权衡关系：通过分解获得的准确率提升与由此引入的噪声之间的对比。 DnDScore（Wanner 等人，2025）随后在原始上下文中重新验证每个被分解的子主张，这正是我们作为方法公开发布的完整分支——不同之处在于，他们将其提出为一种修复方案，而我们则将其用作一种工具，用于衡量缺乏该工具所付出的代价。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-format sensitivity. Sclar et al. (2024) is the closest prior result to our FORM main effect: meaning-preserving formatting changes move accuracy by as much as 76 points, which is larger than anything we report. Two things differ. Their variation is applied to a whole prompt, where ours is applied to a single interface inside a pipeline with every other stage held byte-identical; and their design has no content arm, so format sensitivity and content loss cannot be separated. Our depth-3 square crosses the two deliberately, and the answer is that in the 2024 models they compound (interaction positive on all six 2024-cohort models and +0.0550 over all nine, the same order as either main effect) rather than one explaining the other. Tang et al. (2025) report format beating descriptions on a different axis, and Sun et al. (2025) study structured intermediates as a benefit; our list-versus-prose result is the same knob read as a cost , which is what a pipeline exposes and a single prompt does not.
paragraphs.zh: 提示格式敏感性。Sclar 等人（2024）的研究结果最接近我们 FORM 的主要效应：保留语义的格式变化可使准确率提升多达 76 分，这一数值高于我们所报告的任何结果。但两者存在两点差异。他们的变化应用于整个提示，而我们的变化则仅应用于流程中单个接口，且其他所有阶段均保持字节级完全一致；此外，他们的设计没有内容分支，因此无法将格式敏感性与内容损失分离开来。我们的深度为 3 的平方交叉实验有意地将这两者结合，结果表明，在 2024 年的模型中，二者会相互叠加（在所有六个 2024 年队列模型中均呈现正向交互，九个模型中的总效应为 +0.0550，与任一主要效应的顺序一致），而非一个对另一个的解释。Tang 等人（2025）报告了格式在另一维度上优于描述性文本的结果，而 Sun 等人（2025）则研究了结构化中间表示所带来的益处；我们关于列表与散文对比的结果，则是将同一参数解读为一种代价——这正是流程所暴露出的问题，而单个提示则不会。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent failure taxonomies. Multi-agent debate ( Du et al., 2023 ) is the best-known argument that splitting a problem across calls buys something, and it is the premise this paper prices: debate spends several calls to improve an answer, where a pipeline spends several calls to produce one, and only the second design pays at an interface. MAST ( Cemri et al., 2025 ) derives 14 failure modes from 1600+ traces at kappa = 0.88, and MAS-FIRE ( Jia et al., 2026 ) injects faults into multi-agent systems to measure reliability. Closest on the intervention side is Huang et al. (2025) , who inject errors into agents’ responses and report that adding an Inspector agent to review and correct messages recovers up to 96.4% of them. Their Inspector is handed the chat history, so it is grounded in our sense; what their design cannot do is separate a reviewer helps from a reviewer holding the original problem helps , because what the Inspector sees is never varied. That separation is what our grounding arms perform, and it is why the same intervention appears here as an instrument rather than as a defence. These are the observational counterpart to what we do: they catalogue failures in the wild across many uncontrolled differences, and we manipulate one edge at a time with the rest of the pipeline frozen. The two lines agree where they can be compared. MAS-FIRE and Yadav et al. (2026) both report that stronger foundation models do not uniformly improve robustness – independent arrivals at the shape of our generational result, from failure injection and from cooperation games respectively, where ours comes from a registered prediction that we watched fail.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体失效分类法。 多智能体辩论（Du 等人，2023）是最著名的论点，认为将问题分解到多个调用中能获得某种优势，这也是本文定价的前提：辩论通过多次调用改进一个答案，而流水线则通过多次调用生成一个答案，且只有后一种设计在接口处产生费用。 MAST（Cemri 等人，2025）从 kappa = 0.88 时的 1600 多条轨迹中推导出 14 种失效模式，而 MAS-FIRE（Jia 等人，2026）则向多智能体系统注入故障以衡量其可靠性。 在干预方法方面，最接近的是 Huang 等人 （2025），他们向智能体的响应中注入错误，并报告称，通过添加一个“检查员”智能体来审查和纠正消息，最多可恢复其中 96.4% 的错误。 他们的“检查员”会接收到完整的对话历史，因此其判断基于上下文；但他们的设计无法区分“审查员提供帮助”与“审查员掌握原始问题本身所带来的帮助”，因为“检查员”所看到的内容从未改变。 这种区分正是我们的“接地机制”所执行的功能，这也是为何同一种干预方法在此被用作工具而非防御手段。 这些研究与我们所做工作的观察性对应：他们在多种不受控制的差异条件下记录真实环境中的失效，而我们则一次仅操控一个环节，同时冻结流水线的其余部分。 在可比较的范围内，这两种方法的结果是一致的。 MAS-FIRE 和 Yadav 等人 （2026）均报告称，更强大的基础模型并不会均匀地提升系统鲁棒性——这与我们的生成性结果在形态上独立地达成一致：前者分别来自失效注入和协作游戏研究，而我们的结果则源于一个已登记的预测，我们观察到该预测发生了失效。

paragraphs.en: Context loss and repair. Lost in the Middle ( Liu et al., 2024 ) is the standing account of context degradation, and it is positional : information is present but poorly used according to where it sits. Our placebo and dose-response arms are what separate that mechanism from ours. A placebo carrying at least 60% of the tokens and at most one word of the problem recovers nothing ( -0.0100 / -0.0050 / -0.0100 ), and the recovery curve is flat through half the problem, with 15% to 40% recovered at three quarters, so the effect tracks what is missing , not where anything sits . On the repair side, R3 prompting ( Tian et al., 2023 ) re-grounds a degraded context and adaptive injection decoding ( Jin et al., 2025 ) intervenes mid-generation; both are interventions of the kind our per-stage grounding arms apply, but applied to improve a system rather than to localise a defect within it. We use grounding as an instrument: re-grounding exactly one stage is what makes STAGE_TAX(i) an attribution rather than an improvement. The closest prescription to ours comes from a different object: Kwon (2026) compresses a model’s memory at a fixed budget and finds that what survives decides whether a later correction can be acted on – keep the recomputable source, drop the conclusion that can be re-derived from it – defended, as ours is, with a length-matched control. Ours is a message between two stages rather than a memory across turns, and our outcome is clean accuracy rather than recovery from a delivered correction, but the two prescriptions rhyme: what an interface keeps matters more than how much of it there is.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文丢失与修复。 《迷失于中间》（Liu 等，2024）是描述上下文退化的经典研究，其核心在于位置性：信息仍然存在，但根据其所处位置而被低效利用。 我们的安慰剂组与剂量反应组正是将这一机制与我们方法区分开的关键。 一个至少包含 60% 标记、最多仅包含问题中一个单词的安慰剂无法恢复任何效果（-0.0100 / -0.0050 / -0.0100），且恢复曲线在问题的一半范围内保持平坦，直到四分之三处才恢复 15% 至 40%，因此其效果反映的是缺失的内容，而非信息的位置。 在修复方面，R3 提示（Tian 等，2023）通过重新建立上下文基础来修复退化的上下文，而自适应注入解码（Jin 等，2025）则在生成过程中进行干预；两者都属于我们各阶段基础构建机制的范畴，但前者用于优化整个系统，而非定位系统内部的缺陷。 我们将“基础构建”作为一种工具：仅对单个阶段进行重新基础构建，正是这一操作使 STAGE_TAX(i) 成为一种归因方法，而非单纯的改进手段。 与我们方案最接近的方法来自另一个研究目标：Kwon（2026）在固定预算下压缩模型的记忆，并发现保留的内容决定了后续修正能否被有效执行——即保留可重新计算的来源，而舍弃可从该来源重新推导出的结论——这一方法与我们一样，通过长度匹配的控制组进行了验证。 我们的方案是两个阶段之间的信息传递，而非跨轮次的记忆保留；我们的结果关注的是纯粹的准确性，而非从已给出的修正中恢复信息。但这两种方案存在相似之处：接口保留的内容比其容量大小更为关键。

sents.en: The closest prescription to ours comes from a different object: Kwon (2026) compresses a model’s memory at a fixed budget and finds that what survives decides whether a later correction can be acted on – keep the recomputable source, drop the conclusion that can be re-derived from it – defended, as ours is, with a length-matched control.
sents.zh: 与我们方案最接近的方法来自另一个研究目标：Kwon（2026）在固定预算下压缩模型的记忆，并发现保留的内容决定了后续修正能否被有效执行——即保留可重新计算的来源，而舍弃可从该来源重新推导出的结论——这一方法与我们一样，通过长度匹配的控制组进行了验证。

sents.en: Ours is a message between two stages rather than a memory across turns, and our outcome is clean accuracy rather than recovery from a delivered correction, but the two prescriptions rhyme: what an interface keeps matters more than how much of it there is.
sents.zh: 我们的方案是两个阶段之间的信息传递，而非跨轮次的记忆保留；我们的结果关注的是纯粹的准确性，而非从已给出的修正中恢复信息。但这两种方案存在相似之处：接口保留的内容比其容量大小更为关键。

paragraphs.en: Test-time compute. A pipeline spends more inference compute than a single call. A large literature studies how to spend it well: compute-optimal allocation ( Snell et al., 2024 ) , inference scaling laws across strategies at matched budget ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , the same allocation posed as an explicit optimisation problem ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , and allocation across the heterogeneous subtasks of a multi-stage task ( Wang et al., 2025b ) . AgentTTS states plainly that prior test-time scaling work is single-stage, which is also our starting observation. The difference is what is held fixed. That literature varies the budget and asks how best to spend it; we hold the design fixed (same stages, same calls, same budget) and vary one interface, then ask what it cost. Treating multi-LLM collaboration as an optimisable graph ( Wang et al., 2025a ) makes the same object we measure, the edge between two stages, into a search space; our contribution is the price tag on an edge, which is what a search over edges would need and does not have.
paragraphs.zh: 测试时的计算资源消耗。 一个流程所消耗的推理计算资源比单次调用更多。 大量文献研究了如何高效利用这些资源：计算资源的最优分配（Snell 等，2024）、不同策略下在相同预算内的推理扩展定律（Wu 等，2024）、将相同的分配问题表述为明确的优化问题（Wang 等，2025a），以及在多阶段任务中跨异构子任务的资源分配（Wang 等，2025b）。 AgentTTS 明确指出，以往的测试时扩展研究都是针对单阶段任务的，这也是我们的初始观察。 区别在于哪些要素被保持固定。 那些文献通过调整预算来探讨最佳分配方式；而我们则保持设计不变（相同的阶段、相同的调用、相同的预算），仅改变一个接口，然后考察其成本。 将多 LLM 协作视为一个可优化的图结构（Wang 等，2025a），会使我们测量的同一对象——即两个阶段之间的边——成为一个搜索空间；我们的贡献在于为这条边赋予一个成本标签，而这正是边间搜索所需但此前尚未具备的信息。

paragraphs.en: Error propagation, arrived at from elsewhere. The closest external result to ours comes from software engineering, not from reasoning research. Konstantinou et al. (2026) study LLM-generated test suites and find that a stage which reads a previous stage’s output does markedly worse than one that works independently: fault detection falls from 25% to 14% when tests are generated after the code rather than beside it. Different field, different task, no contact with this work, and the same structure as the tax. We take that as support rather than competition, and it also sharpens what is ours: they encountered the effect as a confound to be avoided in a study about something else, and so did not ask what the loss is about , which is the question Section 3.2 and Section 3.3 answer.
paragraphs.zh: 错误传播，这一结论来自其他领域的研究。与我们最接近的外部成果来自软件工程领域，而非推理研究。Konstantinou等人（2026）研究了由大型语言模型生成的测试套件，发现一个读取前一阶段输出结果的阶段，其表现明显劣于独立运行的阶段：当测试在代码生成之后而非同步生成时，故障检测率从25%下降至14%。尽管领域不同、任务不同，且与本研究并无直接关联，但其结构与“税”模型如出一辙。我们将此视为支持而非竞争，同时这也凸显了我们研究的独特性：他们在另一项研究中将这一效应视为需要避免的干扰因素，因此并未探究这种损失的具体原因——而这正是第3.2节和第3.3节所回答的问题。

paragraphs.en: On the attribution side, DisasterBench ( Chen et al., 2026 ) introduces First-Point-of-Failure to localise the earliest root cause in a tool-use pipeline and separate primary errors from downstream cascading ones. That is the same problem STAGE_TAX(i) addresses, approached from the opposite direction: they infer the origin from an observed trajectory, while we intervene on one stage at a time and read the recovery. Inference is cheaper and applies to traces that already exist; intervention is what licenses a causal claim about which stage the tax belongs to. CORRECT ( Yu et al., 2025 ) builds the same kind of evidence at scale from 2,000+ injected-failure trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 在归因方面，DisasterBench（Chen 等人，2026）引入了“第一故障点”方法，用于定位工具使用流程中最早的根本原因，并将主要错误与下游的连锁错误区分开来。 这正是 STAGE_TAX(i) 所解决的问题，但研究角度相反：他们从观察到的轨迹推断问题起源，而我们则逐阶段进行干预并观察恢复情况。 推理成本更低且适用于已存在的轨迹；而干预则是提出因果主张的依据，即判断该“税”属于哪个阶段。 CORRECT（Yu 等人，2025）通过超过 2,000 条注入故障的轨迹，大规模构建了同类型的证据。

paragraphs.en: Statistics. We report McNemar’s paired test ( McNemar, 1947 ) per cell, and correct within declared families using Holm’s step-down procedure ( Holm, 1979 ) and Benjamini-Hochberg ( Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995 ) . Dror et al. (2020) is the NLP-specific standard our family split is measured against, and its central warning, that a corpus-wide correction over heterogeneous hypotheses answers a question nobody asked, is why §3.1 corrects within families at all. Membership is fixed by each cell’s manifest and never by its outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 统计。 我们按每个单元格报告 McNemar 配对检验（McNemar, 1947），并使用 Holm 的逐步下降法（Holm, 1979）和 Benjamini-Hochberg 方法（Benjamini & Hochberg, 1995）在声明的族内进行校正。Dror 等人 （2020）是我们家族划分所依据的自然语言处理领域特定标准，其核心警告——即对异质性假设进行全语料库范围的校正，实际上回答了无人提出的问题——正是 §3.1 之所以要在族内进行校正的原因。 成员资格由每个单元格的显式信息确定，而非由其结果决定。
